name: Roy Cooper
subject: You're outstanding
body:
I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1699&source=&t=1&akid=4618%2E124072%2E4eONuV) | | | |
---
Peter, I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
My team was going through our supporter records, and we noticed how yours stood out from the crowd. You’re one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that _I know_ how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it.
**Today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here's why:**
Grassroots fundraising has slowed down recently, and it couldn’t come at a worse time. Republican super PACs have poured tens of millions into North Carolina to defeat me, and now, President Trump is coming back to North Carolina to hold a massive MAGA rally with my opponent in three days.
We need to turn this around fast – and the first step is getting our fundraising back on track. [**_Will you chip in $5 right now to help us reach this week’s goal? The stakes could not be higher._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1699&amount=5&t=8&akid=4618%2E124072%2E4eONuV)
North Carolina is the best chance Democrats have to flip one of the four seats we need to take back the Senate, so if we lose here, we lose our shot at flipping the majority. The only way we’ll avoid that is by building the resources to compete with the massive amounts of GOP spending.
**Unlike my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley, I’m not a Washington DC insider who can rely on his billionaire connections to buy this Senate seat. I’m depending on people like you, giving what you can, when you can, at crucial moments like this.**
_With 17 days to go until Election Day, Peter, I need you._
[**_Time’s running out, so I’m personally asking: Will you please chip in your first $5 donation to my campaign today so we can flip North Carolina’s critical seat and help Democrats secure the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1699&amount=5&t=9&akid=4618%2E124072%2E4eONuV)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15913?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1699&amount=5&t=10&akid=4618%2E124072%2E4eONuV)

Roy

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

body:
Tonight, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared.
| | | | **THIS COULD BE MY FINAL 4 WEEKS AS PRESIDENT**
---
[READ MY CRITICAL REFLECTION](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)
[](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)
Never in the history of my Presidency have I sent anything quite like this to my supporters. Dear Friend, this is your only warning. What I’m about to share with you is emotional **- PREPARE YOURSELF.**

[READ MY CRITICAL REFLECTION](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)
The Rose Garden is almost sacred at night.

When the cameras are gone and the noise of the day finally fades, it stops being a backdrop for press conferences and power plays.

It becomes what it was always meant to be: a quiet, living garden right beside the White House.

**_And last evening, in what could be my final 4 weeks as President, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared as I strolled alongside the rose bushes._**

[READ MY CRITICAL REFLECTION](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)

Your faith in me still humbles me more than I can put into words.

From the highest of highs to the lowest of lows, I have always been able to count on your support.

From an unproven, underdog political candidate to the leader of our nation's GREATEST movement in history, you have always stood by my side.

Even when it would have been easier to write me off.

For the past decade, the Radical Left has done everything in their power in an attempt to destroy the MAGA coalition.

They came for me, my family, friends, and above all: my supporters.

People like you, Friend.

When the chips were down, you stared evil straight in the face and never flinched.

You put your career, family, and even LIFE on the line to continue supporting me, and I will never be able to thank you enough.

Every single day I wake up, I pray and thank God for his blessing of being able to be your President.
And every night I go to sleep, I pray for the opportunity to spend one more day fighting to make America Great Again.

**And in the Rose Garden late last evening, I made one final prayer before leaving:**

**__That my supporters will keep their trust in me one final time and help see the rest of my mission through.__**

As you read my message, the Radical Left all across the country are rallying. From our cities to the countryside, dangerous socialists and communists are preparing to destroy our Republican Majorities in the House and the Senate.

I refuse to go quietly and allow the Radical Left one final victory.

After everything we have built - after the strength we restored, the borders we secured, the voices we gave back to forgotten Americans - we cannot stop when we are so close to Making America Great Again.

Here, in the Rose Garden, I’m not asking for your support as President. I am asking for your support as a fellow American who will do anything for his country.

I am asking for one more show of faith. One more offering of trust.

**_[Please, stand with me today.>](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)_**

[](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)
[](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.)
Thank you & God Bless

A president cannot be allowed to create a blanket shield against scrutiny — especially one designed to reach backward and forward at the same time. As the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, I know exactly what is at stake when an administration tries to place itself beyond accountability. House Democrats will fight this in the courts. We will defend Congress’s oversight authority, the separation of powers, and the basic principle that the law applies to everyone. you for standing up for accountability. Robert Garcia = P.S. As the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, I’ll have subpoena power to finally hold the Trump Administration accountable — but only if we win back Congress this November. = = * Paid for by Robert Garcia for Congress Robert Garcia for Congress 65 Pine Ave #348 Long Beach, CA 90802 United States This email was sent to . name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: A GOP midterm warning and a TV forum meltdown
body:
Plus: The new White House press secretary’s rough first day | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TP2pb52R4vG?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Speaker Mike Johnson says the polls are wrong. Realistically, the House is probably gone, and the real fight in the midterms is for the Senate. Kansas is tied, and Iowa, Maine and Alaska are within a couple of points. We go through every close race and explain what it will take for Republicans to hold the Senate.

Also, you have to see this: a Democrat running for county council in Indiana went on local TV and said her plan if elected was to fire all Republicans. That was not even close to the strangest thing she said.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/bzDZ67IDbrw?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🏛️ GOP WARNING: THE REAL FIGHT IS FOR THE SENATE**
Speaker Johnson went on Fox News and said the polls are missing Republican voters, and he has a point. CNN’s Harry Enten found the early October generic ballot has underestimated Republicans in 14 of the last 16 elections.
But polls don’t vote. These are turnout elections now, and right now Democrats are more fired up to show up. If Republicans want to hold the Senate, their voters have to match that.
Scott Jennings also asks the question Democrats haven’t answered this year: what would they actually do differently?
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/OrqakrhORt5?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**📺 AN INDIANA DEMOCRAT’S PLAN: “FIRING ALL REPUBLICANS”**
Jaime West is running for county council in Fayette County, Indiana. A local station asked her what unpopular decision she would make for the good of the county. She asked to hear the question again, then said she would fire all Republicans.
Then she told viewers who she says threatened her. Her last words to voters are why the clip went viral.

**🗳️ LUJÁN LEADS MARKER BY DOUBLE DIGITS, AND CD2 IS A COIN FLIP**
The new Albuquerque Journal poll has Sen. Ben Ray Luján well ahead of Larry Marker. We talk about why New Mexico’s senators keep siding with their party over their state, and the border is the clearest example.
In CD2, Gabe Vasquez leads Greg Cunningham 48 to 44. That’s inside the margin of error, and we break down what it will take for Cunningham to close the gap.

**🎤 THE NEW PRESS SECRETARY’S FIRST BRIEFING**
Katie Zacharia’s first White House briefing did not go well. We remember our first TV live shots, and we explain what she needs to do before the next one.
Ava is home for fall break, and she disagrees with both of us! She doesn’t think someone speaking for the president gets time to grow into the job, and she makes a strong case.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/kHv2nC1rLDh?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**PLUS:** Kacey Musgraves brought James Talarico to her concert, and James Hetfield told a Metallica crowd why his band stays out of politics. A viewer wrote in to defend the Bigfoot film. And it’s our anniversary, so we dug up an old VHS clip from KJCT in Grand Junction, back when we competed for every story.

clean_body: Plus: The new White House press secretary’s rough first day | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com | | | | | | | | | | | | Speaker Mike Johnson says the polls are wrong. Realistically, the House is probably gone, and the real fight in the midterms is for the Senate. Kansas is tied, and Iowa, Maine and Alaska are within a couple of points. We go through every close race and explain what it will take for Republicans to hold the Senate. Also, you have to see this: a Democrat running for county council in Indiana went on local TV and said her plan if elected was to fire all Republicans. That was not even close to the strangest thing she said. | | 🏛️ GOP WARNING: THE REAL FIGHT IS FOR THE SENATE Speaker Johnson went on Fox News and said the polls are missing Republican voters, and he has a point. CNN’s Harry Enten found the early October generic ballot has underestimated Republicans in 14 of the last 16 elections. But polls don’t vote. These are turnout elections now, and right now Democrats are more fired up to show up. If Republicans want to hold the Senate, their voters have to match that. Scott Jennings also asks the question Democrats haven’t answered this year: what would they actually do differently? | | | 📺 AN INDIANA DEMOCRAT’S PLAN: “FIRING ALL REPUBLICANS” Jaime West is running for county council in Fayette County, Indiana. A local station asked her what unpopular decision she would make for the good of the county. She asked to hear the question again, then said she would fire all Republicans. Then she told viewers who she says threatened her. Her last words to voters are why the clip went viral. 🗳️ LUJÁN LEADS MARKER BY DOUBLE DIGITS, AND CD2 IS A COIN FLIP The new Albuquerque Journal poll has Sen. Ben Ray Luján well ahead of Larry Marker. We talk about why New Mexico’s senators keep siding with their party over their state, and the border is the clearest example. In CD2, Gabe Vasquez leads Greg Cunningham 48 to 44. That’s inside the margin of error, and we break down what it will take for Cunningham to close the gap. 🎤 THE NEW PRESS SECRETARY’S FIRST BRIEFING Katie Zacharia’s first White House briefing did not go well. We remember our first TV live shots, and we explain what she needs to do before the next one. Ava is home for fall break, and she disagrees with both of us! She doesn’t think someone speaking for the president gets time to grow into the job, and she makes a strong case. | | | PLUS: Kacey Musgraves brought James Talarico to her concert, and James Hetfield told a Metallica crowd why his band stays out of politics. A viewer wrote in to defend the Bigfoot film. And it’s our anniversary, so we dug up an old VHS clip from KJCT in Grand Junction, back when we competed for every story. | | | ✅ LIKE on ✅ hit the bell ✅ FORWARD to anyone who needs to catch up on the news ✅ at NoDoubtAboutItPodcast.com | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | © 2026 Choose Adventure Media. subject: Bayh Ad Accuses Engling of Reckless Driving Convictions That Don’t Exist

body:
No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-h/) **For Immediate Release:** October 17, 2026**Contact:** Kylie Glatfelter, Communications Director, [kglatfelter@indiana.gop](mailto:kglatfelter@indiana.gop)**Bayh Ad Accuses Engling of Reckless Driving Convictions That Don 't Exist ****Indianapolis, IN **- Republican Secretary of State candidate Max Engling on Saturday demanded that Democratic opponent Beau Bayh pull his latest attack ad and correct its false claim that Engling has been convicted of reckless driving, or face a defamation lawsuit.Engling has never been charged with or convicted of reckless driving. His record includes eight speeding tickets, all traffic infractions, the most recent 16 years ago.In the ad, Sheriff's Deputy Scott Robinett says: "Max Engling has been convicted and investigated at least 8 times for reckless driving and reckless behavior." The public record shows no reckless driving charge or conviction."Beau Bayh can spend money repeating this claim, but he cannot produce a reckless driving charge against me because there isn't one," Engling said. "If Beau has evidence, release it. Otherwise, pull the ad and tell Hoosiers the truth."Engling called on Bayh to identify the record he says supports the allegation, remove the claim from his advertising and publicly correct it."Putting an accusation on television doesn't turn it into a fact," Engling said.Indiana Republican Party Chairwoman Lana Keesling condemned the ad."Fabricating a criminal record to win an election is a new low, and voters should reject it," Keesling said. "Voters deserve campaigns that tell the truth. Beau Bayh wants to run the office that safeguards Indiana's records and elections, and he should start by getting the facts right in his own ad."### [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-r/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-y/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-j/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhlkyid-hhlljjcji-d/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W. Since Abdul won his primary in August, Republican spending has surged. It’s now the most expensive race in Michigan history, and they’re not letting up. Why are they throwing so much at this one specific race? Because Abdul’s message is working, and that terrifies them. I was campaigning with Abdul in Michigan last week, and I saw firsthand the energy he’s building. He’s talking about what working families face every day: prescription drugs that cost too much, rent that keeps climbing, and grocery bills that eat up more of every paycheck. Meanwhile, giant corporations jack up prices, and their wealthy executives keep getting richer. Working families deserve a government that fights for them, not the powerful interests already doing just fine. Abdul is a fighter who has the courage and determination to deliver meaningful change. subject: Humbly asking for your support in the toughest reelection campaign in the entire country
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3106%2E5691347%2EPqTX8C)

Peter,
You know why I’m reaching out — it’s to humbly ask for your support in my reelection campaign here in Georgia.
But before I ask for your contribution, I think you deserve an explanation for why this race is so important, and why I’m asking for your support, particularly right now.
**I am MAGA’s #1 target in the midterms.**
Don’t forget, we’re talking about _Georgia_. The most competitive battleground state _in the country._
And something that folks aren’t paying enough attention to is that National Republicans have vastly more resources than National Democrats right now.
I expect the GOP and their Super PACs will spend _tens of millions of dollars_ against me.
So I’m asking you to take nothing for granted. This is something you can do _right now_ that will have a BIG impact: [**Make a donation to my reelection campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261018-1-f&utm_campaign=em261018-1-f&t=2&akid=3106%2E5691347%2EPqTX8C)
Peter, my campaign won't accept contributions from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. That means the vast majority of the donations that fuel this campaign come from emails just like this one. People chipping in $10, $25, or $50 at a time.
And the money we raise _right now_ means we mobilize more voters in every corner of the state, place more ads to spread my message across Georgia, and hire more staff to sustain and even expand our efforts.
And while I certainly don't expect you or anyone else to donate to every email my team and I send, I hope you'll consider donating to this one today.
[**Can you please make a $5 contribution to my reelection campaign today? My team and I will put every single dollar to work building the strongest possible campaign, but it’s only possible if lots and lots of people like you decide to get involved.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261018-1-f&utm_campaign=em261018-1-f&t=3&akid=3106%2E5691347%2EPqTX8C)

Sen. Jon Ossoff

## Trump Waives Sanctions on Russia
President Trump signed an executive order on Friday evening to [waive many sanctions sought to put pressure on the Kremlin](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ_GdI48g81P4WIbumy7JZrAEGZlILInRPftr7ivcOtz9J2ff_fxTpJkf_6ljaMux7jzpyRW5Tw-uOic5WRd87voyivTKVx0RIeNBWehG2lSOXn0VM1xYUauK47Q9lhD2zuo1vgIoYfWc9ej8713bV078PxAQEfBcyXx4oGDDpwLzt2aDuYO0TehXubQBeMdz6JHvv0_ZNeVl_R1nJxv07FVKa6qr2LqPwYHg8PVU1K6NIPDemx8TTI40LzJLkUzqRy7waGBEBoEq_m9veyH5ORi87sUod0W2qfLVyxNapWyLMtFqXKcXx9JSUrTGu-eG8lPWKW__O-M-B0AAP__MViFbw) to end its military operations against Ukraine. The Graham Act, signed into law last month, would have imposed sanctions on all goods brought into the U.S. from the largest importers of Russian crude oil and gas. Trump said the waiver was in the ["national interests of the United States."](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQAL8GOp9sYw4oXKShe2lTImMvxybGRt4F5_4-uvzC60ej0fz6Wr4cRkyvn-4Ay1teElSKwAxlWYE4FLyB93IR77CDuxGIFy31Uygp1Lg4z3jDYlwb7AagoWvBqmHSnRomqdrdqsmsap16FfygR2025X0ngwnSDKZXfYv241NSjUrKXsrHc1Rh1No8-24L_dg3RkJAzuXxO2PiHbb4zjeUh89HG-3OfFLT_Wj03Oi51vrY8t_1IkxA9GEaPZ85IqOnRs9cruMU1eENJA6X3qJcROiSIJc8Y04krhSgiARVRFfF6vwfCCJiCgRv8Spud0dbbDgrxoj0HBojX4fD-L-IvznytvpfAAAA___uQ4uH) The decision comes after an announced deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin last week to release hundreds of thousands of tons of Russian [diesel fuel onto the global market as fuel prices soar.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ8GOh_ZBvNTuEhDd9OmRHvs5bCRMci7gPL2EbfIC6SdGX2amV9f8xdQovz5CRt6WfY5480JRbDMb2SJhS6UtZwsK64IFyHLbLXtlNHKDDMEoQvnFuroF0SLTY3e9KNtTD9qU69ex9i8wfXWwTj2wdk2DAah091iW3B9Tf7hGW0Go7XT-tUNJg7Wtp1rlugGV7UaI8leXr93yrLikv7sF5ZX2Lc6-VXk4Kr5UdmpstN936_8Ds-Ox6_sdOyJhAJXdpJyboeCuFEmlgJCe_4n88kH5sgq463KyUygGHJ4QqwiQlLHWcIKjCoSMiYVSCh_VP4GqRIydLoZR1MXH4-bUiLu-qrVnw0ofdeV_3z58vZvAAAA__-tGpX9) Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Saturday [criticized the "unfortunate" decision](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unDAQBeCnMZ1XtvndwkUaups2JZrFwzKJsZFnAG2ePiKvcJtpRvp0zvn1NX0BRUrvn7ChlyVPCS-OKIJleiFLKHSirOVgWXFFOAlZJmdcp63RdphgFjpxaqAKfkF0WFfobf90te2fxlarH_oau34I3RPgZeelwYABoRuWrq1tjRX527PGDtaY1phHN9gwONd0bb2EdmhVYzCQ5PL4nSnJikv85BPLY85bFf0qsrOqfyg3Kjemz55Z7pdy4w0rN1pzn1658colBn2XVG78ixET__noVwQW1kdacpEjgaAOOBNTTlqy3uFg1OVgJtAMaRbKiTWw3jLP-dIrCes9X1j0HiHJjVfFh_2iGIm7XjXmvQHF_4nlm0Of3v0LAAD__1u4lcU) to hold back new sanctions on Russia after the country released more devastating attacks on his country's energy infrastructure.
## Details Emerge in Oregon School Shooting
The bystander who stepped in to stop a gunman at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday is [_a father who has two daughters at the school_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAURL8Gd6wAL7a3oEjj7qVNaWEzLDfC5glubO3fR84vpBtppNGc8-tr-fKU6Xj_9Dscx7IcuFoGM-qyonGodIJT_dM4IcGfhMaLUWaQWkk9LX5jOrE8fRdcBAz6Dk6PL9Pr8aV0l9w6xBDjto0B1tt1GBEtXsbYXg_QHh25e08rPWmlrFKPYdJhMuY52D4GO1nxVAjEpT5-Fzo4IeZPOVEfW9m77BLzdxP9D2FmYebruh7b2m6OuxdmvqMwc6l4l0O2LZWSZUulMKpcP439EVAlBRxMkRBko3yiyuopS2TsONjXjzBzV134vihnasMonuq9e8r_bvB_2jud-RsAAP__auKIbQ). Police said Kaylub Giamanco pursued and fatally shot the 16-year-old attacker, ending a rampage that took the lives of three children and a teacher and wounded two others in a special needs classroom. The gunman, Griffin J. John II, was once a special needs student at the elementary school. [_Authorities praised a teacher_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ_G7jjBgm0oKNJc96dNafGbxWyEzQk2Pt3bR84rpByNNJrv-_W1fgUqdO4_w4GeU11PfPeCzNjWb-wcG13Iuf3pnDFjuAg7ryBhFkoKZdewMV24mjBGnxAB9YheLQ60WpxUY_YqqSlFY1xcEizWQnRRodRg0reW0Yzk7z0llVVSTlI-ZquiBTDzpFOc7DQYiZG4tsfvSidnTOVTL2yPrR5j8Zn51Qf9Y4DnAM_wuhHu6g6NaSs4wLM23Osp-pZrLaLnWpnOXXQqFzbRAhWBBQ88ObSPcNYpKwPO6EIAjHMwoN1mURvQ0k5j8_H1plKoz8tg5H4EKv_u8H9avDz8DQAA___YLoae) who threw her phone at John, then tackled and fought with him before he was shot by Giamanco. Senior law enforcement officers said [_John 's weapon had been legally purchased by his mother_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE8DmZFtwAOBg03I_qYbIn-7wT0y7pHdA5rbr1jtDX72pJJKVe_P1_rlMGHef7sDLG-0ZrhqAmYo6zdUDgVP4FjelSNEcCdC5VVLbYSSQk2r84wnrINrg90ANPQtWPWYda8es1RttH703shBqVHNzijnBxecNnqeh9AbN7Zo7z4l1aSkHKXszKTCpPVgxn4L4zQ2g4SATKV7EmaOsKUPnVA6T0ebbGR-1ab_1eil0ct1XV3-9vePO2_0cmOjl3cV_4kK7JRF9ZEoiRqJGIrAAJlxQwhCGfEBVwSlIJ4Us9gLbhtmgSiuSBXEQSyKz87IfpZTW2x4XZgSVvNoBrkfDtO_dfxDqafVfwMAAP__nqKNtA), Shauntai Nickerson, around the time of his August birthday.

**Whatever happened to Paul Harvey?** _" Hello Americans, I'm Paul Harvey. Stand by for news!"_ If you grew up in a house where the kitchen radio stayed on, or listened to the AM radio in the car, you can still hear it. The pause. The scoop in the voice. The way he said _Page two_ like he was turning an actual newspaper over at the breakfast table. Paul Harvey was born in Tulsa in 1918 and got his first radio job at 14, sweeping floors at KVOO until somebody let him near a microphone. He went national on ABC in 1951, and from there, he simply never left. At his peak, Harvey reached more than 24 million listeners on over 1,200 stations, plus 300 newspapers carrying his column. He earned it the hard way. Up at 3:30 a.m., a bowl of oatmeal, then hours combing the wires and calling editors around the country for the small, strange, deeply American stories nobody else bothered with. [You can hear many of those stories here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkEtugzAURVdjZkH-gDEDD6omVP0kjVqpdIaM_QiODCTwAKWrr9ItdHqvdI50yn21Nz74_nQwHWhshqqHdQqACGNVw4Ru9AtgO84TttCCWTxMWHHK5YbRDVOVsegXqBITOd0AcBARaJblXLAspyxqdQ3O5tI6oai1VprMytpkomYqr1PGVeT1nccoU4zSlNJYKuYU54lMReNSlZKEgvM4jPF58D220ITbsMAY26GLgm4RLxMRD4QXhBfrusa3Yca5hvt_XwzalohiIWLb06JgYmai3BEug5-QiO3xbSev593z12P53bz6a1dl82fy9HJ8V4ePcvlBFo3aXVYfgp9kRhJ66owPf3r8Z7VF898AAAD__2K4gHU) He wrote his own copy and read his own commercials, which is why half the country bought whatever he said he and his wife, Angel, used at home. Here's one of his most famous essays, _[If I Were the Devil,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LuO6yAUheGnwV0sLr6QguJIZ9IlM92UCMwmEBETwTZW3n7keYVp15K-4v--6quJKa73m3mCQp_1CntNgAhFW6joSmyAoWwVAwQwLUJFzSmfToyemNRmwdhAD6ZzygNwEB0oNp-5YPOZsi4oI61w1M2z92CGiU3WGrGcx9kzLqQ1XVSHxyiTjNKR0n6SzEnOh2kU3o1yJAMFFzGX_pHjigF8eucGpV_ys0sqIL4qEf8IvxB-2fe9f-cNNwvHfywGl0DEpRHx_7F-fcht_Lyl2hXlXntMKdZpJgO9P01MvyT-sURT_CcAAP__aipzDg)_ from 1965. Then, in 1976, came the five minutes that made him immortal. [_The Rest of the Story,_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM1u4jAURp_G2RFd_8QkCy-QmEjDwFC6KN1FTnyDjQxB8U0i-vQVfYVuv086RzrnQ3OwIYb75b-9oaF-aO64pIhEODYtJnJjmJH8OCXy6NHOARM1AoRecVjxsrEdhRkbZTNnekSBMkPD15WQfF0Bz7xpkVfQKat03-qeY4ml7FCovmuxKsBlwbx4HHjJAQqAXJfclUIoXcjeFWXBFKALNIz5dQh38tjH5zDjmHfDLYvGEz0SkxsmaibqZVny5zDR1OLrfy2WOs9kPTO5PYXj9Kd44u4DmNAxJGJy-7bnF_0e93SuT5uj-1pd_36C--d3Zz81qt10bTYa91hCjCHpNVNwudkQf_T0y2qzEd8BAAD__-L9gUE) written by his son Paul Jr., would walk you through some forgotten tale and hold back the name until the final beat. _" And now you know... the rest of the story."_ Then: _" Paul Harvey... Good day!"_ Harvey died in 2009 at 90, still on the air after 58 years. Rush Limbaugh, who called him "probably the best ambassador radio has ever had," took the personality-driven AM format Harvey invented and pointed it at politics. Harvey mostly pointed it at people. The good news is that his show is not really gone. WGN in Chicago brought the old episodes back in 2020, and in Wisconsin, you can still hear _" The Rest of the Story"_ twice a day on WRJN in Racine and on WRCO in Richland Center. Both stream free across the country, so no matter where you live, there's still Paul Harvey... Good day! _Do you remember listening to Paul Harvey broadcasts? If you grew up in a house where the kitchen radio stayed on, or listened to the AM radio in the car, you can still hear it. The pause. The scoop in the voice. The way he said Page two like he was turning an actual newspaper over at the breakfast table. Paul Harvey was born in Tulsa in 1918 and got his first radio job at 14, sweeping floors at KVOO until somebody let him near a microphone. He went national on ABC in 1951, and from there, he simply never left. At his peak, Harvey reached more than 24 million listeners on over 1,200 stations, plus 300 newspapers carrying his column. He earned it the hard way. Up at 3:30 a.m., a bowl of oatmeal, then hours combing the wires and calling editors around the country for the small, strange, deeply American stories nobody else bothered with. He wrote his own copy and read his own commercials, which is why half the country bought whatever he said he and his wife, Angel, used at home. Here's one of his most famous essays, from 1965. Then, in 1976, came the five minutes that made him immortal. written by his son Paul Jr., would walk you through some forgotten tale and hold back the name until the final beat. " And now you know... the rest of the story." Then: " Paul Harvey... Good day!" Harvey died in 2009 at 90, still on the air after 58 years. Rush Limbaugh, who called him "probably the best ambassador radio has ever had," took the personality-driven AM format Harvey invented and pointed it at politics. Harvey mostly pointed it at people. The good news is that his show is not really gone. WGN in Chicago brought the old episodes back in 2020, and in Wisconsin, you can still hear " The Rest of the Story" twice a day on WRJN in Racine and on WRCO in Richland Center. Both stream free across the country, so no matter where you live, there's still Paul Harvey... Good day! Do you remember listening to Paul Harvey broadcasts? ## Streamer Turns Austin Into a $50K Game
Kick streamers are expected to [_descend on Austin_](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAURp8Gb1hw_RcGhi7e0rWjheE6vgqGyNza6dtXaR6h85G-T-d8Xaero0jp9uk2tPxc8pTwLBGZcZ86dXffhSkV3tFtuN_chpDCMYGCXmol9WVynunAqXVVsLMKRldo9WCgAd1oU61W-X5oltbPYBS61jTt7LvOLLPqujB4qMi-5rTSF62V7qAO_dL3oHFpzcWg8aJVGIjzXvOKjE9XlviTD9xrn7cq2pX5UUTzIWAUMJ7nWd-fLr2ggPHlI2CM2bsoYHwLCRjJo3zkghRyknhgYklJvrE8V8eSiiQWMFa7DY-TYqTSD6JVt81R_Lvm_yY7LPwGAAD__3-MgRo) on Saturday for a shot at $50,000 in Safe Zone, a real-life video game from streamer Ice Poseidon, whose real name is Paul Denino. Think Fortnite on city streets. Contestants walk Austin while livestreaming, and their phones' GPS places them on a shared digital map. Denino controls a circle that can move, shrink, or split; anyone caught outside is out. Viewers can spawn zombies and other hazards.[_The last player inside_](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQgOGnMVuiu4ux8eAhQ5EqNVXVpSNy8JFYNRDhC6FvX6Wv0PUfvuH_OnWnkHKaLu9hZC_bMHcTP0pmEV66Gr7DvUiaiiwcRl4uYWSa4toRkNkh7LDpQi9p5U6HKvozRIcVe7SODoQHdNXVQ3BwbqC3NpLVNQd7RhwMOKtNjzxUyT85BGwQAWvaRzMYQ8iDdo1j1ysNHJPMy16uLLyFMuSfeeVl389jlf1V5FbU4aioVdRuz6qo_Xw5vr32_DEXTnGeFLVFgtyLopYQTIMOHTY1aXBAdbX4eHuknFMxVmm4jCHlP1_--2X19BsAAP__mqdzsw) wins. Entry is open to anyone streaming on Kick. Austin police [_said they support participants_](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO6yAQheGnwV0iZjAYCoo07nJ1uy0RsYcELbYjmDjZt18lr7DtKT4d_V_ncI655PX6Ly7k-ZW2sNKzFWKmGrT8jo_GeW1cKS5Ur3EhXOc9oERzAHkAG-LEeafQx272Fzk76MjD4FAhKHDdzU_OKTclpa22ESFp1w8yYdLaJnWB1GX_5kCCBZCg8TibZAwCpd5ZR24SvaQ581aPfCOmV2yp_Gw71eO0LV3xN-Z7E-okcBQ4vt6rwPH0uR7-byVPJHBsHPnRBI4IAGBx6I1CKTUa67rq5_szl5KbGUQvr0vM5aPzX6vsHn8DAAD__9Ngc1I) but urged everyone to stay safe.
## Second Glitch Delays Voter Updates
A Texas.gov error [delayed about 15,000 voter registration updates](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTGOpDAQRU9jMrfsMhgICDYhm003RIVdZqwxuGVXw_TtV8weYbOS6ulJT__Px_KBMcVj-407Tfwd8nLQVRMxU1k69YWvyvGoXAh3KhvuBIc_F1BgpVZSDws6jictLTZ-WpUfdUOT7kcwoI0em89pxS4MCnvdG6tMMB05N9iAxgQYkaCJ063TSg9aK93Bw9tgLWgK7TiMNDrRKvKRc3nwJzF9Yw3pnU8qD5f3Jk2fzM8qzC8Bs4D5uq7H1_mi-ylgxsLRJRIw32UC5mdOkaO7zzMzyR-hgLkyMsmL1hqZJJWSi_SU8F3_IfKmiyy0xcoFOeZDvp4emapcKeRCkrCk983FYxMwgx1l64wywXbSj9rJ1gclV4-rDEEZZ0LoV2-bMvnnFVOK1faiVduOMf208f9uck7wNwAA__-fi6Me) from reaching election offices in Travis, Williamson, and Hays counties, the Texas Secretary of State's office said Friday. The glitch hit voters who used the state portal to update information tied to their registration. Williamson County processed its roughly 700 files overnight and said no voters there were affected. The error surfaced days after state officials said counties had cleared a much larger backlog caused by [a separate DPS software problem](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLtytCAUx58GOx04uogFxdfY7demdLgcXCYoO3Cim7fPuHmE9P_r7-O-3E1McV__mw01vUJedjxrQiIsy41_mq9Kca9U0GxYVrMh7P5YgINsBW-FWoyjeOAymMZry_0kGtRinKAH0YupeWhrArgbehWsdYpLNzo1grNhUNbJnjdRX3GCCyUEFzfovAxSgsAwTGrCybGBo4-US0cPJHyZGtJ3PrB0Lm9N0g-iZ2X9PwYzg_k8zy7k1_g7_ZIwmK9XDOa3ufXP2h6ZsLQF11ipGIp5b7GUXJqi_fOMKcUqRzbwdTMxvXvor3wODT8BAAD__8aJfMk). Travis County Voter Registrar Celia Israel said her staff has worked overtime: _"We are all hands on deck."_ Voters who registered by the Oct. 5 deadline can still cast ballots when early voting opens Monday or on Election Day, Nov. 3.
## Rollins Offers Cotton Farmers Insurance Fix
U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins [told farmers in Caldwell](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAQBeDT4AyLKv8SEGzibDbd0GKgcKPBZgTVds_tV-4rTFIVPOnT0_v3sX7YmOKx_bU7GX6FvB501UTMVNZBfdln5XhULmR3KpvdCQ9_rqhwlKAkzKt1HE9ae9t486m8hoYMTBo7hA508zBdsGp2YXQh9AH6wc3eQT8pPU046Klrork5UDADKBiw9WMYRwQKvZ41aSd6RT5yLi0_iOlla0g_-aTSurw3yTyYv6vo_ghcBC7XdbVfn_y6Q4HLbQtcQN1nErjYTVZyhdiWH3nZclT5NqXLz-RlypVksGWnUmUO4X41pyfHfFSBS1OM_75iSrGOk-jVttuY3kX4twOeBv8HAAD__7vLhPQ) on Friday that cotton growers will be able to insure against both hurricanes and drought on a single policy starting in 2027. Growers now must pick one or the other. _"If having to make this decision ahead of time doesn't drive you to drink, making the wrong decision absolutely will,"_ one farmer said. Rollins also said USDA will press Bangladesh, Indonesia, and other countries to buy more American cotton. Brazil overtook the U.S. as the top cotton exporter in 2023. Texas growers insured about [97% of their cotton acreage in 2024](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0MGO4yAQBNCvwTdb0BBiDhz24ltWK-1Ic7Q6pnHQYDuCjp35-1HyC3MtlV5J9XkZL5hyWue_uJDnZ9zGlY6aiZnKeJJf-Kic1sqFcKEy40Kwhn0ECbZVslX9iBOnnUaDTfBXGZxqyKuzAw1KK9fc_HWK9hpQa-hdr3HSk4NgwTlpjbNGNsm_OCVVr5RUJ-iCjdaComhc78hNwkgKibfS8Y2Ynlhj_t52Kt20LU32N-Z7FfqPgEHAcBxHVxbsHjVgN2-7gKEmpipgCBTxkVnAEFN-JyDh1EotYPh4ue1_Rqb2X9lehRYkmO4eYlN8uB8p51TtWRg5L5jye5x_e9ru4ScAAP__Fv9_Hw), when crop insurance paid more than $1 billion in cotton claims. Rollins warned the country will keep losing "tens of thousands of farmers and ranchers every year" unless farms profit more than two years in 10.

Marshall has put his party and politics ahead of the people he was elected to represent. That’s why we need an independent-minded, solutions-oriented leader who will listen to Kansans and fight to make their lives better.We need Adam Hamilton. subject: MAGA Republicans thought they could draw us out!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF GLORIA JOHNSON, LISA SORENSEN, TREASURER
body:
As you've likely noticed, this election season isn't quite going as they'd planned...

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/484601b36997/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363946?e=dc5f639d62)

| | | | |
---
|

| |

Friends,
MAGA Republicans tried their hardest to divide us. They redrew our congressional maps in May - a power grab without precedent in our state's history. They thought they could demoralize Democrats, carve good candidates out of their districts, and cling to power. But as you've likely noticed, this election season isn't quite going as they'd planned...
From Memphis to Knoxville and in between, progressive Democratic candidates are undeterred. They're outraising their Republican opponents, they're running strong campaigns, and they're poised to shock the country in November.
Take my friend, State Rep. Justin Pearson. Recent polling shows Justin is [within striking distance](https://us.list-manage.com/LM5ncb12Zcg?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) of an upset victory in Tennessee's 9th congressional district. Just last week, the national Democratic Party moved Justin's campaign to its ["Red to Blue" list](https://us.list-manage.com/amy2D2sh_t2?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0). This is yet another sign that Justin is running a campaign that can actually win, and Democrats and Republicans alike are taking notice.
Days after that news, [Time magazine](https://us.list-manage.com/yl23wAae32B?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) profiled Justin's candidacy, where my friend said it best:
_“This is just another challenge that we are going to face, and we're going to face it together. And we're going to show up more than we have in decades. We're going to participate more than we have in decades because our voting rights are on the ballot.”_
As Early Vote is beginning, it's time for all of us who care about the future of our state and country to stand strong with these Democratic candidates. Organizations like [TN Rise PAC](https://us.list-manage.com/BwriVn5ECPp?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) are doing vital work to bolster Democratic candidates like Justin who are best-positioned to win in competitive races. Polling shows that these candidates can win, but only if enough voters hear their message and turn out to vote. I support the work that TN Rise PAC does and they can use your support. [Learn how you can support the work of TN Rise PAC](https://us.list-manage.com/mIdoafjXYap?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0).

Thank you, and let's go win this!
Gloria

---|---|---
_**by[Lawrence Winnerman](https://substack.com/redirect/41da63a6-c89d-4904-857b-6c9498ffcf07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
**CONNERSVILLE, INDIANA (The Daily Whatever Press) **-- Asked at a candidate forum what unpopular decision she'd make if elected to the Fayette County Council, Jaime West gave the only answer in the history of candidate forums anyone has ever remembered.
"Firing all Republicans."
She did not stop there, because she is Jaime West and she had no notes. Like, literally, she had no notes. "I wouldn't let them. I mean, I don't even talk to them. I don't like them." Then, being fair: "There are good Republicans out there." The MAGA ones, though, she called "racist" and "not very intelligent." And when the moderator asked for her closing message to the voters of District 4, in a county where she says people have threatened her life, she thought it over and said, "We have guns too."
Don't believe me? Watch it for yourself:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c316b073-133f-496b-a9c7-1fd662528cab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The forum ran Friday, October 9, on LocalTV3, co-sponsored by the _**Connersville News-Examiner**_ , whose managing editor, Amy Graham-McCarty, moderated with the composure of a woman who has moderated a great many things in Fayette County and never once this. West's segment starts about thirty-three minutes in. By Tuesday, the clip was on Mediaite, the _**New York Post**_ , Breitbart, the Blaze, TMZ, and, naturally, Libs of TikTok, which posted it with the caption "This is NOT a skit." By midweek, BuzzFeed counted 8.2 million people engaging with it. The whole county has about 23,000.
### **Who she is**
Jaime West is a mother of three grown kids. She owns Queen Bee's Cleaning LLC. She delivers groceries and packages around Fayette County for a living, and she said so on camera like it was the most normal credential in the world, because it is. She opened by saying she had no prepared statement and would speak "from my heart," and then she did exactly that for several minutes, and the heart in question turned out to have opinions about ICE "coming into our communities, stealing people's jobs." Yes, mama!
She came to clean house, and instead she won the hearts of every fed-up red state Democrat in the country. Hell, I live in Indiana, and if it didn't mean voter fraud (which isn't prevalent and always seems to be a Trump voter, anyways), I would drive a couple hours south and vote for this hero myself.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=220927026&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjIwOTI3MDI2LCJpYXQiOjE3OTIzMjMzNjcsImV4cCI6MTc5NDkxNTM2NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.VLDLMO5DVvBrkY-ogiH_8pxcHmjYWzwAmMNpDnmAEh4)
Her Republican opponent, Gary Keener Jr., did not attend. He had "prior business commitments," so he sent a statement for the moderator to read aloud, and it said he had "never been more excited and committed to work diligently and tirelessly" to spend tax dollars efficiently and broaden the tax base. Graham-McCarty read it. I assume she read it well. Nobody has posted a clip of it, because nobody has ever posted a clip of a tax-base statement, anywhere, ever.
So that is the matchup in District 4: one candidate who showed up with nothing but herself, and one candidate who sent a fax from 1991.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/51a60894-b944-4b39-a73b-9388df16f1b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **What the outrage machine thought it was doing**
Fayette County went for Trump by about 77 percent in 2024. There is no public polling on this race, because there is never public polling on a county council race, because until last Friday nobody outside Fayette County knew it had a council. The right-wing content industry found the clip and did what it does: it tried to turn a woman who cleans houses in Connersville into a national exhibit of Democratic derangement. Libs of TikTok asked whether she was intoxicated. Blaze Media's Steve Baker decided she was "clearly drunk or high." Zero Hedge got involved, which is how you know a story has reached the part of the internet where everyone is a doctor.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b3994463-8e5d-43fc-846f-589ff4609f1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
###### This data is presented as part of a partnership with Polymarket
Nothing has been confirmed. Not one of the people diagnosing her was in the room, and I am not going to be the forty-thousandth guy on the internet with a medical opinion about a stranger in a thirty-second clip. What I will say is that the people clutching their pearls hardest over "We have guns too" are the same people who spent the last decade posting family portraits where everyone, including the toddler, is holding an AR-15. A Hoosier Democrat says one sentence about the Second Amendment, and suddenly the _Come and Take It_ crowd needs a fainting couch. _**SHUDDER...**_

body:
You’ve seen the emails

Derek, if your inbox looks anything like mine, you’re probably getting a lot of emails like this. Subject line: “please.” Subject line: “PLEASE.” Subject line: “please please please please please.” I’m not going to do that to you. You’ve been hearing from me for months now, and I’d rather not spend the last two weeks begging you to chip in. [_**So I’m going to ask the nice, normal way: Tomorrow at midnight, the books will close on our public fundraising deadline. Will you donate any amount before then to make sure we head into Election Day in the strongest position possible?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141648141/654297279/-109723252?refcode=email_101826_desperate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjMxNzlmMS1lOGNhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tUtPYSy8CWuBUp_bYJu0pfxdRwTjuCwhPNURQUiK1dg=) | | [Chip in →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141648142/654297280/-109723252?refcode=email_101826_desperate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjMxNzlmMS1lOGNhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tUtPYSy8CWuBUp_bYJu0pfxdRwTjuCwhPNURQUiK1dg=)
---
Here’s the part I’d actually like you to know (minus the theatrics).

Dear Friend of Life, She can take the pregnancy test at home. **Find the abortion pills at home.** Order them at home. Have the package delivered to her door. And she may go through the abortion **in that same home.** No waiting room. No face-to-face conversation before she makes the decision. Perhaps no one beside her when she goes through what follows. This is how dramatically the abortion pill has changed the fight for life. A woman can be frightened and overwhelmed one moment, reach for her phone the next, and begin moving toward a decision **she cannot undo.** And when the abortion is over, the decision doesn't simply disappear. What happened privately in her home is now something she has to live with. **We want to reach her before she gets there.** PreBorn! partners with pregnancy clinics across the country where women considering abortion can receive free ultrasounds and compassionate support. Before she takes the pill, we want to give her the opportunity to see her baby. To talk with someone about what she's facing. To know abortion isn't her only option. When women see their babies through an ultrasound at a PreBorn! Network Clinic, **80% choose life.** And **$28 can help provide one free ultrasound.**

name: Eugene Vindman
subject: 🇺🇸 To all Democrats who want to take back the House: Please don't not skip this message. Not today. ⛅
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
Eugene Vindman needs your support.

**🇺🇸 To all supporters of Eugene Vindman - and Democrats who want to take back the House: Please don’t ignore this message. We have have some final spending decisions to make in the coming days and we are short of where we need to be. ⛅**
Eugene has devoted his life to serving our country: in the Army, the National Security Council, and now as a member of Congress.
But he’s up for re-election against a formidable MAGA opponent who is _attacking him relentlessly._ He’s launched attack ads against him, and even a website dedicated to smearing his record.

Eugene is already a top target for Trump after blowing the whistle on him 7 years ago, and recently calling on Trump to release questionable call transcripts with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. And his race is one of the most competitive races in the country.
So we have no doubt that Eugene will continue to be subjected to limitless attacks by his opponent, Donald Trump, and National Republicans.

**Peter, if we don't have the resources to fight back against these attacks, we could lose this seat.** But to win, it's going to take resources — resources that only this grassroots team can help us build.
But truthfully, we’re seeing a major slowdown in our fundraising, and the timing couldn't be worse as we **with just over two weeks to go in this race.**
The strength of this campaign has always come from people like you who chip in what they can, when they can. Our average online donation is about $27. Some give more, many give less. What matters is that people give to support Eugene when they can. Especially during a critical moment like this one.

So we’re asking:

body:
If this is the first time you’re hearing from me, let me introduce myself.

A state built on faith, family, freedom, and the Second Amendment is being tested -- and its future will shape the country.

| | | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkMGOozAMhp8m3ECJgZAeclipYk_dreYyRxQSQyMlBJlAZ95-RNUXmKN_f7Y--_M23IwPfpn_mYh6Tus60DaYEPAbt7TYFBIZlwbgIEvBS6EGY7M_cGhM4XRjZCOlLFCL7gI1tN2FFw_NRzthy0U9csv51Dqwjaqd4shFJ8AVXp8LBRdKgJCgqqkdlRqFHCcHDmXHGo7O50TV6US4eYdL9iZUNsUi6EfO68bqPwx6Bv2Gdiesnn4hdCfBoD-8zYnKaOirnBKVczqQlkQMeoOlTSUZi6zu9xyHLe10Fte__-_3D9HyS6cYyLMV0fk9svqK0fjwDq2Jq_Hzwurrko53mJFOriDt1qcPwW-vM-Zz7mWdf_vfQ8NPAAAA__9nTYjr)

| | Friend,
---
| | If this is the first time you're hearing from me, let me introduce myself. My name is **Victor Marx** -- a husband, father, Marine Corps veteran, former pastor, and founder of an international humanitarian organization that has carried out more than 150 high-risk rescue missions around the world.I've spent my life stepping into the chaos most people run from, fighting for those who can't fight for themselves.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkMGOozAMhp8m3ECJgZAeclipYk_dreYyRxQSQyMlBJlAZ95-RNUXmKN_f7Y--_M23IwPfpn_mYh6Tus60DaYEPAbt7TYFBIZlwbgIEvBS6EGY7M_cGhM4XRjZCOlLFCL7gI1tN2FFw_NRzthy0U9csv51Dqwjaqd4shFJ8AVXp8LBRdKgJCgqqkdlRqFHCcHDmXHGo7O50TV6US4eYdL9iZUNsUi6EfO68bqPwx6Bv2Gdiesnn4hdCfBoD-8zYnKaOirnBKVczqQlkQMeoOlTSUZi6zu9xyHLe10Fte__-_3D9HyS6cYyLMV0fk9svqK0fjwDq2Jq_Hzwurrko53mJFOriDt1qcPwW-vM-Zz7mWdf_vfQ8NPAAAA__9nTYjr)
---
**_I never expected to run for Governor of Colorado..._** But people I respected deeply -- _including Charlie and Erika Kirk_ -- believed in me and urged me to step forward because they saw what was happening here in our state.After Charlie was killed, Erika reminded me that he believed this was a fight I was meant to take on.**They were right, and I am now fully committed to winning this fight.**[_**Today, I am asking you to join me...**_](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkMGOozAMhp8m3ECJgZAeclipYk_dreYyRxQSQyMlBJlAZ95-RNUXmKN_f7Y--_M23IwPfpn_mYh6Tus60DaYEPAbt7TYFBIZlwbgIEvBS6EGY7M_cGhM4XRjZCOlLFCL7gI1tN2FFw_NRzthy0U9csv51Dqwjaqd4shFJ8AVXp8LBRdKgJCgqqkdlRqFHCcHDmXHGo7O50TV6US4eYdL9iZUNsUi6EfO68bqPwx6Bv2Gdiesnn4hdCfBoD-8zYnKaOirnBKVczqQlkQMeoOlTSUZi6zu9xyHLe10Fte__-_3D9HyS6cYyLMV0fk9svqK0fjwDq2Jq_Hzwurrko53mJFOriDt1qcPwW-vM-Zz7mWdf_vfQ8NPAAAA__9nTYjr)
---
[ **ARE YOU IN? JOIN VICTOR!**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkMGOozAMhp8m3ECJgZAeclipYk_dreYyRxQSQyMlBJlAZ95-RNUXmKN_f7Y--_M23IwPfpn_mYh6Tus60DaYEPAbt7TYFBIZlwbgIEvBS6EGY7M_cGhM4XRjZCOlLFCL7gI1tN2FFw_NRzthy0U9csv51Dqwjaqd4shFJ8AVXp8LBRdKgJCgqqkdlRqFHCcHDmXHGo7O50TV6US4eYdL9iZUNsUi6EfO68bqPwx6Bv2Gdiesnn4hdCfBoD-8zYnKaOirnBKVczqQlkQMeoOlTSUZi6zu9xyHLe10Fte__-_3D9HyS6cYyLMV0fk9svqK0fjwDq2Jq_Hzwurrko53mJFOriDt1qcPwW-vM-Zz7mWdf_vfQ8NPAAAA__9nTYjr)
---
Because here's the truth most people outside our state don't realize: **_Colorado SHOULD still be a_**** _red_**** _state._** Colorado was built on independence, limited government, faith, family, and the unshakeable belief in the Second Amendment. Those values run deep in our history and in our people.But over time, the political establishment and a flood of left-wing ideas have overpowered the very values that made Colorado strong. We've watched our state shift from red, to purple, to blue -- not because the people changed, **but because leadership failed them.**_And that failure matters far beyond our borders._ Colorado has become a testing ground for policies that spread nationwide -- soft-on-crime agendas, government overreach, attacks on faith, restrictions on constitutional freedoms. **If we stop that tide**** _here_****, we stop it from sweeping across America.**
---
[ **JOIN VICTOR!**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyUkMGOozAMhp8m3ECJgZAeclipYk_dreYyRxQSQyMlBJlAZ95-RNUXmKN_f7Y--_M23IwPfpn_mYh6Tus60DaYEPAbt7TYFBIZlwbgIEvBS6EGY7M_cGhM4XRjZCOlLFCL7gI1tN2FFw_NRzthy0U9csv51Dqwjaqd4shFJ8AVXp8LBRdKgJCgqqkdlRqFHCcHDmXHGo7O50TV6US4eYdL9iZUNsUi6EfO68bqPwx6Bv2Gdiesnn4hdCfBoD-8zYnKaOirnBKVczqQlkQMeoOlTSUZi6zu9xyHLe10Fte__-_3D9HyS6cYyLMV0fk9svqK0fjwDq2Jq_Hzwurrko53mJFOriDt1qcPwW-vM-Zz7mWdf_vfQ8NPAAAA__9nTYjr)

body:
#
Abdul El-Sayed's election is one of the most important races in the country not just because control of the Senate is on the line -- although that is, of course, tremendously important.
But if Abdul can win in Michigan it will send a message across the country that candidates who support health care as a guaranteed human right can win in the swingiest of swing states.
We have a long way to go still, but I just got back from a number of campaign stops in Michigan with Abdul and I will tell you this:
Abdul is not getting attacked by his opponent or super PACs spending to defeat him on the issue of health care. His opponents don't see that as a weakness. The attacks against him are all bigoted, Islamophobic attacks.
And his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, he's not trying to create a contrast with Abdul on the issue. No.
After years of voting to make healthcare harder to get, Mike Rogers suddenly has a whole lot to say about making it better!
Rogers is running ads. He's got a brand-new health care plan. He's even standing in front of cameras asking why prescription drugs cost so much more in America than they do in Canada.
Here is the truth:
This is an election between one person, Abdul El-Sayed, who has spent a career fighting to provide health care for the people of Michigan. And then there's Mike Rogers, who has a fourteen year record voting against some of the most vulnerable Americans.
If Abdul can win, that will be a big part of the message the day after the election. But first, he needs the resources to get it done.
[ Please split a contribution between Abdul El-Sayed's campaign for United States Senate in Michigan and my work electing progressives across the country. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-abdul.jdIzox&refcode=em20261018-12459-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12459%2E2526796%2EqaRUmr)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-abdul.jdIzox&refcode=em20261018-12459-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=12459%2E2526796%2EqaRUmr)**
Here's a short clip from my speech at one of the events in Michigan:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/39178?t=23&akid=12459%2E2526796%2EqaRUmr)
You don't need a medical degree to recognize the symptoms. Something is making this country sick.
And when you're sick, who do you call?
You call a doctor!
Let's help send Doctor Abdul El-Sayed to the United States Senate.
**[Contribute here to help get it done.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-abdul.jdIzox&refcode=em20261018-12459-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=12459%2E2526796%2EqaRUmr)**

In solidarity,
Alexandria
